title: Make project-transport-doctor probe the target Project URL itself
summary: A generic ChatGPT session can be authenticated while the target Project URL redirects to /auth/login. project-transport-doctor should open/probe the supplied Project URL and classify Project access, not just ambient ChatGPT auth.
doneWhen: project-transport-doctor accepts a target Project URL
doctor reports CDP reachable separately from ChatGPT auth and Project access
/auth/login redirect is classified as project-access-profile-missing
tests cover authenticated generic ChatGPT with inaccessible Project URL

title: Split project-source-put failure classes
summary: source-upload-not-verified is too coarse when the root cause may be Project access, wrong URL shape, missing source page, or upload visibility failure.
doneWhen: project-source-put distinguishes project-access-profile-missing, wrong-url-shape, source-page-not-loaded, and source-upload-not-visible
result JSON includes observed URL, target id, target title, and failure class
tests cover at least wrong URL shape and inaccessible Project URL

title: Rank CDP profile candidates by Project access
summary: A known live Project profile solved the blocker, but actor/operator had to find it from proof history. The runtime should list candidates and recommend one usable Project route.
doneWhen: project-transport-env or doctor can list candidate ports/profiles
each candidate is probed against the target Project URL
exactly one recommended route is emitted when possible
known live profile evidence can be supplied as an input pointer without making proof trees canonical

title: Have project-transport-run emit cohesive evidence files
summary: Transport status, readback JSON, artifact manifest, and knowledge JSONL were updated across several manual steps. A cohesive output directory would reduce operator mistakes.
doneWhen: project-transport-run can write a single run directory
run directory includes TRANSPORT_STATUS.md, transport result JSONL, upload result, thread create result, readback result, artifact manifest, and local sha256 list
semanticApproval, completionApproval, and routeDecision remain false unless explicitly changed by parent authority
manual post-processing is optional rather than required

title: Eliminate profile resolution false positives and expose only the Project golden route
summary: Profile resolution must not treat generic ChatGPT auth, reachable CDP ports, stale profiles, deprecated flakes commands, raw mjs scripts, or proof worktree paths as successful Project access. The normal route should be ops-cdp-core project-transport wrappers proving the requested Project URL itself.
doneWhen: project-transport-doctor or project-transport-env probes the supplied Project URL, not only ambient ChatGPT auth
candidate profiles are ranked by target Project access and freshness
exactly one recommended Project route is returned when possible, otherwise a clear blocker is returned
raw/deprecated/proof routes are not emitted as normal actor instructions
tests cover false-positive cases: generic ChatGPT auth but target Project login redirect, reachable CDP without Project access, and stale known-success profile evidence
